summary: Require explicit confirmation for remote mutations, surface incomplete network-overlap inputs as errors, and keep temporary browser-cookie data private and safely quoted.
reason: The generated CLI and code-orchestration MCP surface exposed authenticated writes without enforcing their advertised confirmation controls; network overlap converted upstream failures into false empty results; and Chrome cookie database sidecars could inherit broad file permissions while pycookiecheat profile paths were embedded into Python source without quoting.
validated_outcome: Focused regression coverage and the full Go test suite, race detector, vet, govulncheck, formatting check, and publish-package verifier all pass.
